changes.historical_text: You can equip this card from your hand as an Equip Spell Card to a face-up "Petit Moth" on the field. If equipped, the ATK and DEF of "Cocoon of Evolution" is applied to "Petit Moth".
changes.summary: Two period behaviours the printed text never carried, both present only in goat/c504700067.lua: the equip activation takes a cost gated on Duel.CheckSummonedCount() and calls Duel.IncreaseSummonedCount(), so equipping this Monster Card from the hand consumes your Normal Summon for the turn; and its EFFECT_EQUIP_LIMIT is registered with EFFECT_FLAG_CANNOT_DISABLE, so the card stays equipped while Spell effects are negated (the upstream annotation names Imperial Order). The modern script has neither. Chronology is unresolved: nothing in the packet or the shared chronologies dates when either ruling stopped applying, so no effective bounds are asserted.

review.notes: The GOAT cdb text matches lineage v2 (DB1-EN148, 2004-10-12) exactly, so the chain starts there. The remaining lineage motion v2 -> v3 (Legendary Collection, 2010-10-01) -> v4 (SS03-ENB09, 2019-08-01) is cosmetic: 'You can target 1 Petit Moth you control; equip this card...' formalises targeting that BOTH scripts already implement (the s.eqtg chkc branch is unchanged across the diff, and no EFFECT_FLAG_CARD_TARGET line appears in the diff), and 'the original ATK/DEF... becomes' names the EFFECT_SET_BASE_ATTACK/EFFECT_SET_BASE_DEFENSE pair that both scripts already use. The remaining diff lines (Duel.IsTurnPlayer(tp) vs Duel.GetTurnPlayer()==tp, RESET_EVENT|RESETS_STANDARD vs RESET_EVENT+RESETS_STANDARD, listed_names id vs MODID) are notation-equivalent. The second upstream code 511600069 is 'Cocoon of Evolution (Anime)', a different card (Larvae Moth equip with turn-counter evolution Summons), and is excluded rather than folded in as a variant. Because the single recorded change has no chronology, format applicability will fail safe rather than pick a version - that is the intended outcome, not an omission.
